title: A first look at Polish spelling and sounds
description: A few letters and letter pairs that are new to English speakers.

blocks.text: Some Polish letters and letter pairs are new for English speakers. The English comparisons below are only approximate, to help you make a start. Listen to native speakers to fine-tune the sounds.

blocks.note: The pair sz sounds like English sh, and ł sounds like English w. Roughly: SHKO-wa.
The pair cz sounds like ch in church. Roughly: chahss.
The letter c sounds like ts in cats, and ó sounds the same as u. Roughly: TSOOR-ka.
